label: EU-gpsr-2023 Article 41

obligations.text: The Union shall finance the following activities in relation to the application of this Regulation:

The Union’s financial assistance to the activities under this Regulation shall be implemented in accordance with Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2018/1046 of the European Parliament and of the Council (31), either directly, or indirectly by delegating budget implementation tasks to the entities listed in Article 62(1), point (c) of that Regulation.

The appropriations allocated to activities referred to in this Regulation shall be determined each year by the European Parliament and the Council within the limits of the financial framework in force.
